5184.title: [release/4.150.x] Disable RAW and DNG image decoding
5184.body:
[release/4.150.x] Disable RAW and DNG image decoding (#5184)

Context: https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5162
Requires: https://github.com/mono/skia/pull/376
Changes: https://github.com/mono/skia/compare/c1b1143575de5610719d8c9d43e18aaa8f058508...579fa81eeed6906732e27b7d95149538584dd20b

Backport retirement of the bundled RAW/DNG decoder to the M150 release line.
The previously enabled RAW path preferred a usable PIEX embedded JPEG preview;
otherwise it tried DNG development. A preview can have lower resolution and
baked-in processing. Retire the entire path without introducing a replacement
reader.

~~ Retire RAW decoding without changing the public ABI ~~

Set skia_use_dng_sdk=false and skia_use_piex=false in shared GN generation.
Remove conflicting platform flags and the DNG-only Alpine __WORDSIZE
workaround. Keep SKEncodedImageFormat.Dng = 10 for source and binary
compatibility; the enum value no longer implies that decoding is supported.

Remove the unsupported Gallery choice and move its original DNG fixture
byte-for-byte into test content. A non-skipped regression asserts null results
for codec, bitmap, and image factories, with Unimplemented reported by the
file and managed-stream codec paths. Update related user and build docs.

~~ Stop downloading unused RAW sources ~~

The paired mono/skia#376 DEPS backport comments out dng_sdk and piex so
synchronization no longer fetches them. Remove their Component Governance
registrations and repin both the submodule and manifest to the actual native
release merge 579fa81eeed6906732e27b7d95149538584dd20b. Its tree matches
the reviewed native head. No C API, milestone, or unrelated upstream changes
are introduced.

The macOS ARM64 source build passed with both source directories absent before
and after synchronization. GN args and Ninja dependencies exclude the RAW
codec and both retired libraries. The unfiltered release console solution
passed: 5,750 passed, 20 existing skips, and no failures. Gallery shared built
without warnings or errors. Other native platforms and upstream Bazel were
not tested locally.

Co-authored-by: Matthew Leibowitz <mattleibow@live.com>
Co-authored-by: Copilot App <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>
